name: Camping Mühlleiten
beschreibung: The Camping Mühlleiten in Schönau am Königssee is located in the Austrian state of Tyrol. This campsite is near the famous Königssee, one of the purest alpine lakes. The pitches are suitable for tents, caravans, and campervans. Guests can enjoy hiking and cycling in the surrounding mountains. Water sports on the lake are also available. The infrastructure includes modern sanitary facilities and a small shop.
